messages:
sam: FYI CI started failing a bunch of SAST/DAST runs an hour after the RBAC cleanup. Seeing KMS Decrypt AccessDenied on artifact unwraps; blocking a few release PRs.
sec-bot: alert: scan-coordinator failures=73 fail_rate=0.26 delta=+21% recent_errors=["KMS:AccessDenied", "http:401"] link: https://ci.internal/runs/22021
ivy: Can someone paste a short log snippet? Curious which principal is being rejected.
raj: sample: `2024-07-01T11:02:03Z scan ERROR unwrap artifact=gh-4521 error=AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::666666666:assumed-role/scan-exec-role/scanner is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:666666666:key/11aa-22bb` We moved scanner from SA->role assume in infra PR #550.
zoe: That matches the roll. Key policy probably still lists `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood` as allowed principal. Easy fix: add the new role ARN to the KMS key policy.
ops-oncall: Can we avoid disabling scans entirely? I can open a soft-fail waiver for the scan jobset for 2h. Would prefer that while you triage.
sam: Yes please open soft-fail. Also we should enable a CloudTrail filter for KMS Decrypt failures so we can correlate quickly.
sec-bot: created alert: KMS-decrypt-accessdenied-spike -> channel=eng-security severity=warning link: https://alerts.internal/alerts/12021
ivy: Quick plan: 1) soft-fail waiver (ops-oncall) 2) patch key policy in staging and smoke decrypt (raj/zoe) 3) re-run subset of failing jobs 4) tune SAST heuristics if false positives (marie) 5) add RBAC->KMS preflight to infra PR template (sam)
marie: Noted a bunch of false positives from `hex-literal` and `long-string` rules hitting generated protobuf and fixtures. We should add a repo pattern whitelist (e.g., `gen/**`, `fixtures/**`) and lower severity for those rules.
raj: I'll prepare a minimal key-policy statement to add both `arn:aws:iam::666666666:role/scan-exec-role` and `arn:aws:sts::666666666:assumed-role/scan-exec-role/*` to cover assume variants. Who can apply in staging?
zoe: I can apply in staging. Please paste the exact key ARN and I'll test decrypt with an archived artifact.
sam: key ARN is `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:666666666:key/11aa-22bb`.
zoe: Applying staging patch now.
sec-bot: incident created: "scan-decrypt-denies-after-role-change" id=INC-20240701-03 link: https://inc.internal/INC-20240701-03
ops-oncall: Waiver created: SCAN-SOFTFAIL-20240701-03 duration=120m id=WAIV-20240701-03
zoe: Staging policy updated. Smoke decrypt successful: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://artifact.c --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:666666666:key/11aa-22bb --profile staging-scan` -> OK.
marie: Re-ran a small batch of failing SAST jobs in staging: unwraps fixed, but `hex-literal` hits remain on two repos that still generate long constants. I'll land a suppression PR that whitelists `gen/**` and downgrades severity.
raj: After staging validation, I'll push the key-policy change to prod. Also propose adding a CloudTrail metric filter for `kms:Decrypt` AccessDenied and an alert rule with a playbook link.
sam: Agree. Add a Lambda that annotates the CI run when AccessDenied is seen, pointing to the infra PR that last changed scanner principals. That will speed future triage.
marie: PR opened for SAST config: https://git.internal/sast-config/pull/199 (whitelists + severity tweak + tests).
ops-oncall: Prod key-policy updated and decrypt smoke passed against archived artifacts. Waiver will remain until CI baseline stabilizes.
sec-bot: alert resolved: scan-coordinator failures decreased to baseline. note: WAIV-20240701-03 expires in 90m.
raj: Action items captured: - infra preflight check to detect KMS key policies referencing principals removed by an RBAC change (sam) - CloudTrail filter + alert + Lambda annotator for KMS Decrypt AccessDenied (zoe) - SAST heuristic tuning PR (marie) - runbook update with RBAC->KMS checklist + smoke commands (sam) - postmortem note and timeline (raj)
sam: I'll add a new chapter to the scan-runbook: "When changing scanner principals -> key-policy checklist" with sample `aws` commands, smoke test, and rollback options (re-add inline SA policy, or revert infra PR).
marie: Quick mitigation guidance for devs: if you see a failing SAST that looks like generated code, add `// SAST:ignore` where applicable or request a suppression via the repo-config template.
zoe: I'll add the CloudWatch metric filter and a Grafana panel showing key-level Deny counts. Also wiring the Lambda to post a CI comment when it detects AccessDenied with the KMS key and principal.
sam: Nice. Recommend we also include a pre-merge CI check that scans changed infra roles against KMS key policies in the same account and warns on potential mismatches. Low-effort script in infra repo should do it.
ops-oncall: Waiver removed early; CI baseline looks normal. Closing this incident after postmortem notes in the channel.
sam: Thanks all. I'll file the postmortem and link infra preflight ticket + SAST PR.
